Q5731.reason: Measured by the uncle’s life and able to divest the uncle upon a move to another state, the brother’s interest is a shifting executory interest pur autre vie.

Q5115.reason: Glycolysis activated at exercise onset forms pyruvate faster than mitochondria oxidize it, so lactate dehydrogenase converts more pyruvate to lactate.

Q5932.reason: During 80–90 minutes of intermittent high-intensity exercise, catecholamine-driven hepatic glucose output commonly exceeds muscle uptake and blood glucose rises about 1–3 mM.
